moisture-v2-m7-20261117.description: Two-stage track moisture: stage1 = carry-over + weather + race drift - seasonal OOS bias; stage2 = shift 2R+ by 1R official error (M7).

v2_schema.note: Per-race key `v2` is append-only and independent of v1 fields (predicted_moisture etc.). stage1 is saved once before 1R; stage2 once after the 1R official anchor and strictly before each race start. effective = value the prediction logic should use (stage2 if saved before start, else stage1, else v1 fallback).
